My Process

A Glimpse Into My Beta Reading Process

Every manuscript deserves a thoughtful reader, and that's exactly how I approach every story. I read from a reader's perspective while paying close attention to:

  • Character development
  • Plot holes and story logic
  • Pacing and flow
  • Emotional impact
  • Dialogue and character voice
  • Consistency and continuity
  • World-building
  • Reader engagement
  • Overall reading experience

I genuinely love reading because every story offers a new world, new characters, and a new perspective. There's something rewarding about seeing an author's vision come to life and understanding how a story makes readers feel.

How This Works

Three services. Book one, or book all three.

Beta reading, editing, and cover design are each their own thing here — priced, ordered, and delivered separately, so you only pay for what your manuscript actually needs right now.

01 — Beta Reading

A real reader's honest, detailed reaction: pacing, character consistency, plot holes, and where engagement drops.

02 — Book Editing

Developmental, copy, and line editing — structural feedback and sentence-level polish, bundled into one service.

03 — Cover Design

Amazon KDP cover design for ebook, paperback, and hardcover — so your manuscript and cover are ready together.

Meet Your Editor

Emmanuelle Ann

A dedicated beta reader and book editor, I commit focused time each day to in-depth reading, thoughtful analysis, and detailed note-taking, ensuring that every manuscript receives thorough, honest, and actionable feedback.

My approach transforms each project into a deeper exploration of storytelling by identifying strengths, uncovering areas for improvement, and providing clear guidance to enhance the reader's experience. Beyond offering an editing service, my lifelong passion for books and storytelling gives me a strong understanding of reader expectations across genres and enables me to help authors refine their work, strengthen their narratives, and bring their vision to life.

FAQ

Common Questions

How do I pay, and what happens after?

Choose your package under any of the three services and click Pay & Order to check out. Right after payment, send the requested details (listed under each service) to my email so your order can start on time.

What if my manuscript is longer than the package I want?

Message me first with your word count and I'll send a custom quote — please don't order the wrong package, since pricing and turnaround are tied to word count.

Can I book more than one service?

Yes — beta reading, editing, and cover design can each be booked separately or together. Order each one you want individually through its own package grid.

What genres do you work with?

Dark romance, fantasy (including mature themes), paranormal, and contemporary fiction.

What if my manuscript needs more work than expected?

If your manuscript needs more time than expected, I'll reach out before your deadline to discuss options — you won't be left wondering.

How fast do you respond to messages?

I reply within 24 hours.
